description: 对比两期数据，计算差值和增长率
notes: 对比方式: 同比/环比
分组维度: 根据需求
排序: 按变化值排序
必须计算差值和增长率
sql_template: SELECT COALESCE(a.{{dimension}}, b.{{dimension}}) AS {{dimension}}, COALESCE(a.{{base_value}}, 0) AS {{base_value}}, COALESCE(b.{{current_value}}, 0) AS {{current_value}}, (COALESCE(b.{{current_value}}, 0) - COALESCE(a.{{base_value}}, 0)) AS delta, ROUND((COALESCE(b.{{current_value}}, 0) - COALESCE(a.{{base_value}}, 0)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(a.{{base_value}}, 0), 2) AS growth_rate FROM ({{base_subquery}}) a FULL OUTER JOIN ({{current_subquery}}) b ON a.{{dimension}} IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.{{dimension}} ORDER BY {{sort_column}} {{sort_direction}}
